retrospective_status: Designed after AZH findings and LUTSeg metadata were inspected; class-balanced variants were added after the unweighted pilot was observed; not preregistered.
scope: Different task from AZH four-class wound type; not an external validation of the AZH classifier.

always_absent_reference.description: Fixed constant comparator; not a trained or selective model.

protocol.target: Binary image-level presence of at least one class-4 necrotic-tissue pixel in source reference mask metadata.
protocol.caveat: Derived from segmentation metadata, not a separately clinically adjudicated binary diagnosis; threshold is any pixel.
protocol.grouping: Five outer patient-disjoint folds; within each outer training pool, five group-disjoint inner folds separate classifier, temperature, and selector fitting.
protocol.selection: Matched: per-fold test-score ranking. Fixed: threshold from calibration scores, frozen before held-out evaluation.
protocol.posthoc_class_weight: Balanced loss variants were added after inspecting unweighted pilot results and remain exploratory.
protocol.data_usage: Authors' published train/validation are pooled for this new exploratory grouped CV; no LUTSeg-trained weights are used.
protocol.limitations: 39 patients with leprosy-related ulcers; repeated observations, small inner subsets, synthetic binary target, no independent external cohort or clinical validation.
